name: Good King Henry

schedule.notes: Refrigerate seeds 2 weeks first. Slow to start; perennial after year 1.
Year 2+: harvest spring shoots like asparagus; young leaves like spinach; immature flower buds like broccoli.

harvest.cues: Spring shoots: 6 in tall, snap cleanly. Leaves: 4 to 6 in, arrow-shaped. Flower buds: tight green clusters before opening.
harvest.storageNotes: Fresh shoots in damp paper, fridge 1 week. Leaves wilt fast — best fresh.

varieties.name: Good King Henry
varieties.notes: Medieval kitchen-garden perennial. Tolerates shade few other greens accept.

notes: Triple-purpose plant — spring shoots, summer leaves, broccoli-style buds. Lives 10+ years. Slightly oxalic like spinach; cook briefly before eating. Niche perennial worth knowing about for a shady corner.
